title: Numbering restarts docx 001
notes: real numbering part, raw XML: word/numbering.xml replaced wholesale with one abstractNum (lvl 0 decimal "%1.", lvl 1 lowerLetter "%2.") and two w:num instances — numId 1 plain, numId 2 with w:lvlOverride w:ilvl="0" w:startOverride=1 — so the second 5-item list restarts its decimal counter at 1; body paragraphs reference the lists via w:pPr/w:numPr (w:ilvl + w:numId), items 3 of each list at ilvl 1 to exercise lowerLetter. The template's own numbering part was dropped: its abstractNums were only referenced by unapplied built-in list styles. Reference text is the exact item strings only — number markers are render-derived, not inserted text.
